The FTC source concerns the named online service. It separately attributes the September 2024 allegations to the complaint and describes the final order, $193,000 relief, notice to 2021–2023 subscribers, advertising substantiation and January 16, 2025 approval. It does not establish current compliance, capabilities or individual consequences.
